name: AcademicEval
description: A live benchmark for evaluating large language models on long-context academic writing tasks using papers from arXiv. It includes tasks such as title, abstract, introduction, and related work generation, with no manual labeling and features live evaluation to prevent label leakage.
reputation: AcademicEval is a recent live benchmark for long-context academic writing and is designed to reduce label leakage, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Addresses label leakage and rigid context length issues in existing benchmarks; uses expert-curated few-shot demonstrations.
